scope: All fresh route-related named candidate windows and known admitted original windows. Raw signed internal-call operands, actual relocation records, full target hashes and exact normalized/raw target matches. Inferred original boundaries need not equal historical Rust functions; candidate execute fuses loop and hop source, so no size-based one-to-one correspondence. Data previews do not establish consumed extents or transitive data equality.
